source: A Daily Prayer
Holy Spirit, fill me!
Pray for the Holy Spirit to work in you and through you.
target: 祷求圣灵在你里面工作与运行。

source: Jesus, protect me!
Put yourself under the protection of Jesus' blood and sacrifice.
target: 在耶稣的宝血与祂的牺牲之下受到保护。

source: Heavenly Father, give me whatever gift I need today.
target: 阿爸天父，赐我今日所需。

source: God can give you everything you'll need this day.
target: 神可以赐予你今日一切的需要。

source: Thank you, God, for my life and everything you're giving me.
target: 感谢神，祢给我的一切和我的生命。

source: Say thanks in and for everything.
Put on the whole armor of God
Helmet of Salvation
God, protect and change my thoughts.
target: 上帝，保护与改变我的思想。

source: Breastplate of Righteousness
Thank you, God, for your grace by which I'm saved.
target: 感谢上帝，因祢的恩典我得救赎。

source: Belt of Truth
God, help me to speak truth and to live according to your truth.
target: 上帝，帮助我说出真理，以祢的真理而活。

source: Shoes of Readiness
God, help me to see situations where I can share about you and help me to do it.
target: 上帝，帮助我发现可以分享福音的机会。

source: Shield of Faith
God I trust you. Let my faith in you grow.
target: 上帝我信靠你。然我在你里面的信心成长。

source: Sword / God's Word
God, help me to understand your word better and to use it.
target: 上帝，帮助我更加的了解与使用祢的话语。

source: (Ephesians 6:10-17)
